apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.title: Create PDF Signature Field from Stream
apply-pkcs7-detached-digital-signature.description: Loads a PDF from a file stream, adds a placeholder signature field (for a PKCS#7 detached signature), and saves the updated document.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Certificate and Timestamp
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and apply a digital signature using a PFX certificate, adding a visible signature field and a timestamp from a TSA.

encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password and Disable Printing
encrypt-pdf-disable-printing.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with a user password, restrict permissions to disable printing, and save the protected document.

encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.title: Encrypt PDF with Owner Password and Restrict Copying
encrypt-pdf-owner-password-high-res-prin.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set an owner password, allow high‑resolution printing, and disable copying.

decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.title: Decrypt PDF with Owner Password using Aspose.Pdf
decrypt-pdf-with-owner-password.description: Shows how to open a password‑protected PDF with the owner password, remove its encryption, and save the unencrypted document using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.title: Add Visible Digital Signature to Second PDF Page
add-visible-digital-signature-second-pag.description: Loads a PDF, creates a visible signature field at the bottom‑right corner of the second page, signs it with a PKCS#1 certificate, and saves the signed document.

add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Apply Invisible Digital Signature to PDF
add-invisible-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add an invisible PKCS#7 digital signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf without affecting the document layout.

extract-signature-field-metadata.title: Extract Signature Fields and Certificate Info from PDF
extract-signature-field-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, enumerate its form fields, identify signature fields, and retrieve any attached X.509 certificate details.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf.title: Extract Images from Signed PDF Pages
extract-images-from-signed-pdf.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates through each page, extracts embedded images, and saves them as PNG files.

remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.title: Remove Digital Signature Fields from PDF
remove-digital-signature-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate signature form fields, delete them when permissions allow, and save the resulting unsigned document.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card.title: Create PDF Signature Field Using a Smart Card Certificate
sign-pdf-with-smart-card.description: Demonstrates locating a certificate with a private key (e.g., from a smart card), adding a signature field to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, and saving the document for later signing.

sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.title: Sign PDF with Smart Card Certificate (No PIN Prompt)
sign-pdf-with-smart-card-no-pin.description: Shows how to sign a PDF using a certificate stored on a smart‑card without prompting for a PIN, leveraging Aspose.Pdf's PKCS7 and signature field APIs.

custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.title: Encrypt and Decrypt PDF with Logging
custom-security-handler-logging-pdf-acce.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with user/owner passwords, log the encryption details, then open (decrypt) the encrypted PDF while logging the access attempt using Aspose.Pdf security features.

restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.title: Restrict Copy‑Paste in PDF with AES‑256 Encryption
restrict-copy-paste-in-pdf.description: The example loads an existing PDF, applies AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, and sets permissions to allow printing while disabling content extraction (copy‑paste). The protected PDF is then saved.

sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Sign PDF with Timestamp from TSA
sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a digital signature to a PDF and apply a trusted timestamp from a Time‑Stamp Authority using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-digital-signature.title: Validate Detached PKCS#7 Signature and Certificate Chain
validate-pdf-digital-signature.description: Shows how to verify a detached PKCS#7 signature for a PDF (or any data file) and validate the signer's X.509 certificate chain using .NET cryptography APIs.

validate-pdf-signature-crl.title: Validate PDF Signature with Revocation (CRL) Check
validate-pdf-signature-crl.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates through its signature fields and validates each signature while checking revocation status via CRL distribution points. Uses reflection to enable revocation checking when supported.

extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.title: Extract Signature Signing Time and Convert to UTC
extract-pdf-signature-signing-time-utc.description: Shows how to read the signing time of each digital signature in a PDF and convert it to UTC using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSignature facade via reflection.

extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.title: Extract Certificate Chain from PDF Signature
extract-certificate-chain-from-pdf-signa.description: Demonstrates how to read a signed PDF, extract the signing certificate and its full certificate chain, and save each certificate as a DER file using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.title: Sign PDF with Reason, Location, and Contact Info
sign-pdf-with-reason-contact-location.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate while setting the reason, location, and contact information, and adding a visual signature image.

sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.title: Sign PDF with Visible Image Signature
sign-pdf-with-custom-image-appearance.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using a certificate and display a custom graphic image as the visible signature appearance.

sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.title: Lock Form Fields After PDF Signing
sign-pdf-lock-specific-form-fields.description: Demonstrates signing a PDF with a visible signature using a certificate and then setting selected form fields to read‑only to prevent further edits.

sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.title: Lock PDF After Adding Digital Signature Field
sign-pdf-and-lock-readonly.description: Shows how to add a signature field to a PDF and then make the document read‑only by encrypting it with no permissions using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Set User/Owner Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-user-owner-passwords.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, apply AES‑256 encryption, assign user and owner passwords, configure permissions, and save the encrypted document.

encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4 128‑bit and Restrict Editing
encrypt-pdf-rc4-128-bit-restrict-editing.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using RC4‑128 encryption with user and owner passwords and set permissions to allow only printing and content extraction, thereby preventing editing.

decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.title: Decrypt PDF and Extract Embedded Images
decrypt-pdf-extract-embedded-images.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a user password, remove its encryption, and extract all images from each page, saving them as PNG files.

decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.title: Decrypt PDF and Update Metadata with Aspose.PDF
decrypt-pdf-update-metadata.description: Demonstrates opening an encrypted PDF using the owner password, removing its encryption, modifying document metadata, and saving the updated file.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.title: Batch encrypt PDFs using file name passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-by-filename.description: Shows how to encrypt every PDF in a folder with Aspose.Pdf, creating a user password from each file's name and applying AES‑256 encryption with selected permissions.

batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.title: Batch Decrypt Password-Protected PDFs Using a Password Lookup Table
batch-decrypt-pdfs-lookup-table.description: The example iterates through PDF files in a folder, tries a list of possible passwords, and decrypts each document with Aspose.Pdf when the correct password is found.

batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.title: Batch Sign PDFs with Metadata‑Based Certificate Selection
batch-sign-pdfs-title-based-certificate-.description: Demonstrates how to process a folder of PDF files, choose a signing certificate based on each document's metadata (title), add a signature field, and save the signed PDFs.

batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.title: Batch Encrypt and Sign PDFs
batch-encrypt-and-sign-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files with a user/owner password and then apply a PKCS#7 digital signature to each encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.title: Extract Signature Field Names and Page Numbers from PDF
extract-signature-field-names-and-page-n.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and retrieve the names of signature fields together with the page numbers they appear on.

retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.title: Retrieve Reason and Location from PDF Signatures
retrieve-reason-location-from-pdf-signat.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate signature fields, and read the Reason and Location metadata stored in each digital signature.

sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.title: Sign PDF and Add Custom XMP Metadata
sign-pdf-add-custom-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to embed custom XMP metadata in a PDF and apply a digital PKCS#7 signature using a certificate with Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

sign-pdf-with-pkcs7-and-custom-xml.title: Sign PDF and Embed Custom XML Signature Data
sign-pdf-with-pkcs7-and-custom-xml.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using a PKCS#12 certificate, add a signature field, and embed custom XML compliance data as an embedded file.

sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.title: Create Incremental PDF Signature with Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-incremental-updates.description: Shows how to add a digital signature field to a PDF, sign it using a PKCS#7 certificate, and save the document so that additional signatures can be appended later.

sign-pdf-prevent-additional-signatures.title: Sign PDF with Invisible Final Signature
sign-pdf-prevent-additional-signatures.description: Loads a PDF, adds an invisible signature field, signs it with a PFX certificate using Aspose.Pdf, and saves the signed document. The example notes that certification level to block further changes is not available in the used version.

encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.title: Encrypt PDF with Print-Only Permission
encrypt-pdf-print-only-permission.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set user and owner passwords, and restrict permissions so that only printing is allowed.

encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.title: Encrypt PDF with Copy Permission and No Printing
encrypt-pdf-allow-copy-block-print.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, permitting content extraction (copy) while disabling printing.

encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with Printing and Copying Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-print-copy-permissions.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 and set permissions that allow printing and content extraction (copying) with Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.title: Encrypt PDF and Restrict Content Extraction
encrypt-pdf-disable-content-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption, and set permissions that allow only printing while disabling content extraction, then save the protected file.

decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.title: Decrypt PDF, Extract Images, and Re‑encrypt with New Owner Password
decrypt-pdf-extract-images-reencrypt.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF using a user password, extracts all embedded images to files, then re‑encrypts the PDF with the same user password and a new owner password.

encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password (AES‑256)
encrypt-pdf-with-password-aes256.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, applies AES‑256 encryption with a user password and specific permissions, and returns the encrypted PDF as a byte array.

sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.title: Add PDF Signature Field Using Certificate Thumbprint
sign-pdf-with-windows-certificate.description: Shows how to retrieve an X509 certificate from the Windows certificate store by thumbprint and create an empty signature field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-certificate.title: Sign PDF with Certificate from Azure Key Vault
sign-pdf-with-certificate.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a visible signature field, and sign it using a PFX certificate (read from a Base64 environment variable) via Aspose.Pdf's PKCS7 support.

sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.title: Add a Digital Signature Field to a PDF Using a Hardware Token
sign-pdf-hardware-token-pkcs11.description: Shows how to load a certificate from a PKCS#11 hardware token and create an empty digital signature field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-signature.title: Validate PDF Signature Against Trusted Root CA
validate-pdf-signature.description: Shows how to extract a certificate from a PDF signature with Aspose.Pdf, build a custom X509 chain using a supplied root CA, and report validation errors.

validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.title: Validate PDF Signature Timestamp Against Certificate Validity
validate-pdf-signature-timestamp.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each digital signature's certificate and signing time, and checks that the signing time falls within the certificate's validity period.

extract-signature-image-to-png.title: Extract Signature Image from PDF
extract-signature-image-to-png.description: Loads a signed PDF, locates the first signature field, extracts its appearance image stream, and saves it as a PNG file.

extract-signature-images.title: Extract Signature Appearance Images from PDF
extract-signature-images.description: Loads a signed PDF, iterates through its signature fields, extracts each field's visual appearance as an image, and saves the images to a specified folder.

extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.title: Extract Images from Each PDF Page into Separate Folders
extract-images-from-signed-pdf__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, extract all embedded images, and save them as PNG files in page‑specific subfolders.

extract-signature-certificate-chain.title: Extract Signature Certificate Chain and Verify Expiration Dates
extract-signature-certificate-chain.description: Loads a signed PDF, locates signature fields, extracts the signer's X509 certificate, builds the certificate chain, and displays each certificate's expiration date.

custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.title: Apply Security Handler with Warning Overlay and Copy‑Paste Restriction
custom-security-handler-warning-overlay.description: The example loads a PDF, adds a visible warning text annotation to each page, and secures the document by encrypting it with AES‑256 while allowing only printing, thereby disabling copy‑paste.

sign-pdf-flatten-signature.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Signature Appearance
sign-pdf-flatten-signature.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible digital signature to a PDF, apply a PKCS#7 certificate, and flatten the signature appearance to prevent further visual changes.

sign-pdf-remove-annotations.title: Sign PDF and Remove Annotations While Preserving the Signature
sign-pdf-remove-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF with a PKCS#1 certificate using Aspose.Pdf, then iterate through the document to delete all annotations except the signature widget, keeping the signature valid.

encrypt-pdf-with-password.title: Encrypt PDF with Password and Permissions
encrypt-pdf-with-password.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with a user and owner password, define specific permissions, and save the encrypted file using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.title: Encrypt PDF for View-Only Access with Owner Password
encrypt-pdf-view-only-edit-password.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF so it can be opened without a password for viewing, while requiring an owner password to edit or change permissions.

decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.title: Decrypt PDF and Re‑sign All Signature Fields with Different Certificates
decrypt-pdf-sign-fields-multiple-certs.description: The example opens an encrypted PDF, decrypts it, locates every signature field, and applies a new PKCS#7 digital signature using a rotating set of certificates, then saves the updated document.

batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.title: Batch Sign and Compress PDFs
batch-sign-and-compress-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to load multiple PDF files, add a digital signature using a PFX certificate, compress the signed document, and save the result in a batch operation.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs and Archive to ZIP
batch-encrypt-pdfs-archive-zip.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt multiple PDF files with unique passwords using Aspose.Pdf and then package the encrypted PDFs into a ZIP archive.

extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.title: Extract Digest Algorithm from PDF Digital Signatures
extract-digest-algorithm-from-pdf-signat.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates its signature fields, extracts the signing certificate, and determines the digest algorithm used for each digital signature.

sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.title: Sign PDF with SHA-384 Digest Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-sha384-digest.description: Shows how to add an invisible signature field to a PDF and sign it with a PKCS#7 certificate using the SHA‑384 digest algorithm via Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-with-sha512.title: Sign PDF with SHA‑512 Digest Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-sha512.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a signature field, configure a PKCS7 provider to use the SHA‑512 digest algorithm via TimestampSettings, and save the signed document.

sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.title: Create PDF Signature Field with RSA Certificate
sign-pdf-with-4096-rsa-certificate.description: The example loads a PDF and a 4096‑bit RSA certificate, adds a signature field to the first page, and saves the document. It demonstrates setting up a placeholder for a digital signature using Aspose.Pdf (actual signing requires the Signatures package).

sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.title: Sign PDF with ECC P‑256 Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-ecc-p256.description: Demonstrates loading an ECC P‑256 certificate, creating a visible signature field, and applying a digital signature to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.title: Encrypt PDF with Password and Smart Card Certificate
encrypt-pdf-with-smart-card-certificate.description: The example loads a certificate from a hardware security module (smart card) and uses Aspose.Pdf to encrypt a PDF with strong password protection (AES‑256) and specific permissions, then saves the encrypted file.

decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.title: Decrypt PDF Using Certificate from Hardware Token
decrypt-pdf-with-certificate-token.description: Shows how to load a certificate with a private key from a smart card or hardware token and use Aspose.Pdf to decrypt a PDF that was encrypted with that certificate.

batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.title: Batch Sign PDFs Based on Document Type Metadata
batch-sign-pdfs-with-certificate-per-doc.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a set of PDF files, read a custom metadata key to determine the document type, retrieve the appropriate X509 certificate, and apply a PKCS#7 digital signature with a visual appearance using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.title: Batch Encrypt PDFs with Hashed Passwords
batch-encrypt-pdfs-date-password.description: Loads each PDF from a source folder, creates a password from the file name and current UTC date, hashes it, and encrypts the PDF with AES‑256 using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-empty-signature-field.title: Extract Existing Signature Fields and Add a New Empty Signature Field
add-new-empty-signature-field.description: The example loads a PDF, lists all existing signature fields, creates a uniquely‑named empty signature field on a specified page, and saves the updated document.

validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.title: Validate PDF Signature and Extract SAN Entries
validate-pdf-signature-extract-san.description: Loads a signed PDF, finds signature fields, validates each digital signature, extracts the signing X509 certificate, and lists its Subject Alternative Name (SAN) entries.

encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.title: Encrypt PDF with User and Owner Passwords and Remove User Password
encrypt-pdf-with-user-owner-passwords-re.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using both user and owner passwords, then reopen it and remove the user password while keeping the document encrypted.

sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Sign PDF and Flatten Form Fields
sign-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible digital signature to a PDF using a PKCS#7 certificate and then flatten all form fields to prevent further editing.

sign-pdf-first-page-with-digital-signatu.title: Digitally Sign First Page of PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-first-page-with-digital-signatu.description: Loads a PDF from a memory stream, adds a signature field on the first page, configures a PKCS#7 digital signature with visual appearance, and saves the signed document.

disable-content-extraction-form-filling.title: Disable Content Extraction and Form Filling in PDF
disable-content-extraction-form-filling.description: Demonstrates how to open a signed PDF, apply encryption with specific permissions to allow printing and editing while disabling content extraction and form filling, and save the updated document.

validate-pdf-digital-signature__v2.title: Validate PDF Digital Signature and Retrieve Certificate Details
validate-pdf-digital-signature__v2.description: Loads a signed PDF, verifies each signature field, and extracts the signing X509 certificate to display its properties.

sign-pdf-with-invisible-certification.title: Add Invisible Digital Signature to PDF
sign-pdf-with-invisible-certification.description: Loads a PDF, creates a PKCS7 digital signature with an invisible appearance, adds a signature field, signs the document, and saves the result.

sign-pdf-certify-allow-form-filling.title: Sign PDF with Certification Allowing Form Filling
sign-pdf-certify-allow-form-filling.description: Demonstrates adding a digital signature to a PDF, setting a certification level that permits form filling while blocking content changes, and saving the signed document using Aspose.Pdf.

compute-verify-pdf-hash-before-after-sig.title: Compute and Verify PDF Hash Before and After Signing
compute-verify-pdf-hash-before-after-sig.description: Demonstrates how to calculate a SHA‑256 hash of a PDF, sign the document with a certificate, then recompute the hash to verify that the content integrity is preserved after signing.

pdf-with-encrypted-attachment-and-signat.title: Create PDF with Encrypted Attachment and Digital Signature
pdf-with-encrypted-attachment-and-signat.description: The example encrypts a file using AES, embeds the encrypted data as an attachment in a PDF, and then digitally signs the PDF with a PKCS#1 certificate.

sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field__v2.title: Create Read‑Only Signature Field in PDF
sign-pdf-and-lock-signature-field__v2.description: Shows how to add a visible signature field to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set it to read‑only to lock the field, and save the document.

add-watermark-and-encrypt-pdf.title: Add Watermark and Encrypt PDF with Aspose.Pdf
add-watermark-and-encrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, apply a centered semi‑transparent watermark, and secure the document with AES‑256 encryption and specific permissions using Aspose.Pdf.
